comparison.objective: Candidate preserves and locks one adjustable robot-gripper stop, then verifies motion; PR-1968 opens three breaker clamps, inserts a comb busbar and tightens all terminal screws.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires simultaneous driver counterholding and thin-nut tightening on one coupled adjustment; PR-1968 requires repeated screwdriver turning plus multi-pin alignment and insertion.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires retained angular calibration over three cycles; PR-1968 requires three inserted and tightened pins that resist a 10 N pull with hands and tool clear.
comparison.reason: Both use a screwdriver, but terminal preparation and multi-pin busbar fastening do not test locking an adjustable screw without disturbing its setting; no rubric details are missing.
